hypotheses.justification: This follows from the other assumptions and `hf`: `IsNoetherianRing R` and `[Module.Finite R N]` give `IsNoetherian R N`, so `Module.Finite.of_injective f hf` supplies `[Module.Finite R M]`. Thus the proof can obtain this instance locally and proceed unchanged. This also covers degenerate cases, since injectivity into a trivial or zero module forces the source to be trivial.
